answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with walks capped at \(t\) steps, so influence cannot travel arbitrarily far. For a Sybil set \(S\), conductance \(\phi(S)=w(S,\bar S)/\mathrm{vol}(S)\) measures its sparse external cut; under bounded ingress and per-edge trust, that cut limits trust entering the cluster and thus bounds its aggregate voting weight. Labels such as ferrous, umber, and garden do not alter the bound.
